title: Simple to use with Advanced Features
body:
I've been trying to find a good habit tracker that suits my needs and purposes. HABITIFY gives all that and some. It looks basic at first glance but when digging in deeper it has a lot more features than meets the eye. I'm paying for subscription and it's really worth the money. 

Overall my experience with this app is great in the past few weeks. I highly recommend this app after trying numerous apps in the past.

title: Widget problem
body:
On iPad, the widget didn’t update the routine that you had done. It’ll stay on the routine list which is kinda annoying because I’m forced to look at it and it’s taking up space for another routine that are yet to be done. Please fix this. I prefer to just glance at the side of my iPad rather than opening the app

Update : They fixed it ! Thank you !
author: T. Farhan

title: They have a serious notification bug
body: If you have many habits to be reminded, don’t use Habitify. What I experienced is that some of the habits will show up in the notifications but some won’t. This is so frustrating that made me missed out a lot of tasks. I have contacted the team to fix the issue, shared my screen recording of the issue, but still they couldn’t find bug and unable to fix it. This issue has been around since the launching of iOS 14. I have paid for a lifetime license, because of this issue couldn’t be fixed, I have requested for a refund, but they don’t want to respond my request. This is bad.
